name: MaskedInput
whenToUse: A value with one fixed format people type character by character: a card number, an IPv4 address, a date in a fixed form.

anatomy.description: TextField’s input and chrome; label it with a Label (htmlFor) or aria-label.
`mask` template with placeholder chars; `showMask` shows it while empty.

do.caption: Groups appear as you type; separators aren’t typed.

dont.caption: Making people strip spaces themselves.
dont.example: <TextField label="Card number" placeholder="Enter 16 digits without spaces" widthSize="md" />

a11y: The format goes in the description too (“16 digits”) — the mask alone isn’t read out.
Known limitation: editing in the middle can move the caret to the end.
Read the raw value with `onUnmaskedChange`, not by stripping on your side.

props.name: error
props.description: Same error prop as TextField — turns the field danger-styled and can carry a message.

props.name: onUnmaskedChange
props.description: Called with the raw value (mask literals stripped) on every change.

props.name: replacement
props.description: Placeholder-char to allowed-pattern map. Default { _: /\d/ }. Pass a string like "#" as shorthand for { "#": /./ }.

props.name: showMask
props.description: Show the full mask template while empty.

props.name: track
props.description: Conditionally transform the entered value before masking.
